scope: Initial evidence review; competitor cohort incomplete

entries.note: Watch choice, duration, percentage viewed and satisfaction inform Shorts ranking. No guaranteed format or minimum posting cadence. Not a clip-level performance observation.
Jenny Hoyos describes immediate hooks and compact storytelling. A creator method, not a universal one-second algorithm threshold.
Meta documents total and average watch time for diagnosing viewer attention. No Clash-specific performance claim.
Structure, early attention and sound are useful test directions. Advertising evidence does not guarantee organic results. Direct creator-clip access remains missing.
ClashterPieces turns player moments into three distinct narrative shorts. Studio-reported campaign reach is not a comparable new-account organic benchmark.
Commenters disagree about 2D and 3D styles. Older self-selected qualitative evidence, not proof of a winning style.
